correctness.rationale: Exact full enumeration of two combinatorial matching cases yields the vertex count and all first and second edge moments. The covariance is explicitly block decomposed into antisymmetric spoke modes, m-1 two-dimensional contrast pairs and a two-dimensional axial block. Direct determinant/trace algebra gives all eigenvalues, their correct multiplicities, positive definiteness, sharp strict hierarchy and the quadratic asymptotic condition number. The standalone file verifies 1,827 exact matrix entries from 4,092 exhaustively enumerated vertices and 999 exact characteristic-polynomial profiles. No finite experiment is substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Vertex covariance is an intrinsic standard Euclidean second-moment invariant of a natural infinite family of full-dimensional matching polytopes, not an arbitrary slice. The theorem exhibits a full five-mode spectral hierarchy, exact multiplicities and extremal eigenspaces, and a quadratic growth law for geometric anisotropy; these do not follow from a skeleton degree count alone. It supplies a reusable exact benchmark for random-matchings geometry and correlation-based ellipsoid comparison.
